entities.name: St. Jerome Cathedral, Ica
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Jerome Cathedral, also known as Ica Cathedral, is a Catholic church in the city of Ica, Peru. It is located on Bolivar street, and forms part of the monumental group of the Company of Jesus.
